UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_AmbientBarelyHear: Never mind. I can barely hear you.
UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_AmbientBreaking: You are breaking up around the—

UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_AmbientGarbled: The last one was garbled. Send it slow.
UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_AmbientNoResponse: No response. Leave it open for another minute.
UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_AmbientNotListeni: I did. You were not listening.

UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_AmbientSendSlow: I said slow. Forget it, just listen for the tone.
UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_AmbientStatic: Static on the line. Thought I heard somebody.
UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_AmbientThing: The thing. The big thing. Just stay put.
UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_AmbientWestHold: Tell the west side to hold.
UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_AmbientWhichChann: Which channel? No, say that again.
UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_AmbientWind: Never mind. Just the wind and a bad connection.
UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_Introduction: My name is {npcFullName}. I speak for {factionName}.

UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_LooterComeTo: Come to {location}. We will be waiting.
UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_LooterSignalTwice: Yeah, free. Just signal twice when you're close.
UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_LooterSurvivors: Any survivors out there, we have food and a safe roof.
UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_MobileMove: We need to move before dark.
UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_MobileNotStay: We will not stay long. Respond if you hear this.

UI_PNC_Discovery_Radio_TraderSupplies: We still have batteries, tools, and two crates of cans.
